as_told.title: Atomic Energy Commission records concluding UFOs are extraterrestrial, possibly tied to AFSWP crash records

plain: Old records of the Atomic Energy Commission, the early US agency for nuclear weapons and power, concluded that UFOs are vehicles from outer space, according to a man named Dylan Borland. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels that Borland said on another show, Weaponized, that the records were held by the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, a Pentagon agency that deals with weapons of mass destruction. At another point UAPGerb leaves that agency out and suggests the records may be tied to crash records of the military's early nuclear weapons project and to the Sandia nuclear weapons laboratory.
